description: NaAg(CO₂)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Pc space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.73 Å. Ag is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Ag-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.62 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.26 Å) and one longer (1.28 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two O atoms. Both C-O bond lengths are 1.27 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ag, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ag, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ag, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ag, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂AgC tetrahedra.
